Smoky Night

A deep, diffused charcoal eye with a soft lip.

Shop this look

About this look

Smoky Night keeps the drama on the eyes: a diffused charcoal gradient, tight-lined waterline and a quiet nude lip so the gaze does all the work.

The direction

  • A diffused charcoal gradient
  • A tight-lined waterline
  • A quiet, balanced nude lip

How to recreate it

  1. Sweep a matte shade across the lid as a base.
  2. Smudge charcoal into the crease and outer corner.
  3. Tight-line the upper lash line and add mascara.
  4. Keep the lip soft with a conditioning nude oil.
